about: خطة معرض العرض (المخطط §9) — يقرؤها scripts/make-showcase.ts. البرومبتات بالإنجليزي (أدق للنماذج)، بلا علامات تجارية حقيقية، والشخصيات مولّدة فقط. مستوى كل قالب في المعرض من content/showcase/campaigns.json (showcase_tiers).

hero.prompt: One continuous cinematic shot: a falcon glides low over golden desert dunes toward ancient sandstone cliffs at sunset; the camera follows just behind its wings, then rises to reveal the vast glowing horizon. Warm amber light, drifting dust particles, calm and epic, natural motion, film grain, no text.

families.video:kling:
FORMAT: 5-second 16:9 cinematic shot, one continuous take, slow motion.
SCENE CONTEXT: a white Arabian horse gallops along a wet shoreline at golden hour, sea spray and sand kicking up.
[00:00-00:02] A low tracking shot just above the waterline as hooves strike the wet sand and water bursts into droplets.
[00:02-00:05] The camera rises slightly and keeps pace beside the horse, mane flowing, backlit by the low sun.
CAMERA: 85mm telephoto, f/2, shallow depth of field, high-frame-rate slow motion, stabilized tracking vehicle.
LIGHTING: warm golden backlight, glowing spray, long shadows.
STYLE: epic equestrian film, warm amber grade, fine film grain.
CLEAN FRAME: free of on-screen text, letters, logos and watermarks.
families.video:seedance:
FORMAT: 5-second 16:9 luxury product shot, one continuous take.
SCENE CONTEXT: a dark oud perfume bottle with gold engraving on black marble, thin smoke curling around the glass.
[00:00-00:02] Macro close-up as a single warm spotlight slides across the gold engraving.
[00:02-00:05] The camera orbits 180 degrees around the bottle, the smoke parting and reflections gliding over the marble.
CAMERA: 100mm macro lens, f/4, motion-controlled orbit, perfectly smooth.
LIGHTING: low-key, one warm spotlight, gold rim light, deep blacks.
STYLE: premium fragrance commercial, black and gold palette.
CLEAN FRAME: free of on-screen text, letters, logos and watermarks.
families.video:veo:

[00:06-00:08] The camera rises to reveal the full skyline against a deep blue sky.
CAMERA: drone, 24mm lens, deep focus, slow steady forward glide.
LIGHTING: blue-hour sky, warm window lights, glowing light trails.
STYLE: cinematic city film, teal and amber grade.
CLEAN FRAME: free of on-screen text, letters, logos and watermarks.
